moral.zh: 沟通不能只顾自己会什么，还要观察和倾听，用对方能理解的方式表达。
moral.en: Good communication means watching and listening, then choosing a way your audience can understand.

idiomMeaning.zh: 比喻对不理解的人讲高深的道理，也指说话不看对象、表达方式不合适。
idiomMeaning.en: Literally, playing the qin to a cow; it describes giving an explanation the listener cannot understand or speaking without considering the audience.

pages.zh: 汉代有位琴师叫公明仪。他抱着古琴，来到绿油油的田野。
pages.en: In the Han dynasty, a musician named Gongming Yi carried his qin into a green meadow.

pages.en: The cow raised her head and listened. Gongming Yi understood: ignore your audience, and even beautiful music may miss them.
